wavelength_spectrum.density: Gaussian optical power per unit wavelength with positive-wavelength support
wavelength_spectrum.turbulence: One common non-dispersive optical path per slab and realization

data.indexing: Arrays use [screen, y, x] or [y, x]. Realization folders are one-based.
data.realization_NNNN/phase_screens_rad.npy: float32 [screens, n, n], unwrapped screen phase at the center wavelength in rad
float32 [screens, n, n], sqrt(spectral intensity) after modulation
float32 [screens, n, n], center-wavelength phase after modulation in rad
data.realization_NNNN/final_amplitude.npy: float32 [n, n], sqrt(spectral intensity) at the receiver
data.realization_NNNN/final_phase_rad.npy: float32 [n, n], center-wavelength receiver phase in rad
data.coordinates/screen_x_m.npy: float64 [screens, n, n], x in m, shared by all realizations
data.coordinates/screen_y_m.npy: float64 [screens, n, n], y in m, shared by all realizations
data.coordinates/final_x_m.npy: float64 [n, n], receiver x in m
data.coordinates/final_y_m.npy: float64 [n, n], receiver y in m
data.average/final_amplitude.npy: float32 [n, n], sqrt(ensemble mean of spectral intensity)
data.average/final_phase_rad.npy: float32 [n, n], circular mean center phase in rad; NaN for zero resultant
data.realization_NNNN/after_screen_center_amp: float32 [screens, n, n], center-wavelength amplitude after modulation
data.average/final_center_amplitude.npy: float32 [n, n], sqrt(ensemble mean of center-wavelength intensity)

images: Amplitude and phase PNGs for every realization and the average. Read the colorbars for scales.
